method: Strata: top = the 250 most-played commanders by EDHREC rank; sample = 200 seeded at random from the rest; extra = rare-keyword enrichment (up to 5 detector hits and 3 loose-word misses per keyword), used for precision only. Two blind raters tagged every commander with every keyword in commander-profile.golden.md; the 118 splits (of 20,100 pairs) were settled by its rulings. Voltron truth re-rated 2026-10-13 under R11 (EDHREC Voltron theme share cross-check): 214 voltron-relevant commanders, two fresh blind raters, 9 splits settled by the ruling.
